notes.title: Boss Battle Mechanic Adjustment
notes.content:
Boss Battle Mechanic Adjustment – Patch Notes
Dear Players,

We have made improvements to the boss battle mechanics to enhance gameplay fluidity and overall experience.

Update Details:
🔹 Boss Battle Control Adjustment

Changed from rapidly tapping the spacebar to holding the spacebar, reducing fatigue and improving combat flow.
🔹 Directional Input Optimization

Players can now use both arrow keys and WASD for movement, providing more flexibility in controls.
Thank you for your continued support! We will keep optimizing the game for a better experience. Stay tuned for future updates! 🎮🔥

— Cooking Path Development Team[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925842/2267aa5f916cf196403511cb92ccad12e00fbf19.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 《烹之道》更新公告
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家们：
 
《烹之道》迎来了一次重要更新，为大家带来了更丰富的游戏体验和更友好的难度设置，以下是本次更新的主要内容：
 
- 游戏难度优化：我们对boss战和过泥潭的相关数据进行了调整，降低了这两部分的难度，让大家在挑战过程中更加轻松，能够更顺畅地推进游戏进程。
- 新年主题更新：为迎接新年，游戏特别推出了新年主题的场景和UI。全新的场景将充满节日氛围，让你在游戏中也能感受到浓浓的年味；同时，更新后的UI界面更加美观、便捷，操作体验也会更佳。
- 游戏模式新增：此次更新加入了简单模式和困难模式。简单模式降低了整体游戏难度，适合操作不太熟练或想轻松享受游戏的“手残”朋友们；困难模式则增加了游戏挑战，为追求高难度的玩家提供了更具挑战性的体验。
 
我们希望通过这次更新，能让《烹之道》给大家带来更多的乐趣和惊喜。感谢大家一直以来对《烹之道》的支持与喜爱，祝大家游戏愉快，新年快乐！
 
《烹之道》开发团队
2025年1月24日

notes.title: Updated on July 4th
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that our latest game update is now live! In this update, we have made some significant improvements and optimizations to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the detailed update notes:

New Player Guide Optimization

- Improved New Player Guide: We have redesigned the new player guide to be more intuitive and user-friendly. The new guide will help new players quickly understand the game mechanics and controls, making your adventure journey smoother from the start.

UI Display Issue Fix

- Collection Display Error Fix: We have fixed the issue with the UI where collection items were not displayed correctly. Now, all collection items will be properly displayed in your interface, allowing you to view them conveniently at any time.

Boss Battle Optimization

- Boss Battle Optimization: We have made comprehensive optimizations and adjustments to boss battles to improve the fluidity and challenge of QTE (Quick Time Events).
- Performance Optimization: We have optimized the overall performance of boss battles to reduce lag, ensuring you enjoy a smoother combat experience.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback. We will keep working hard to improve the game quality. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us through customer service or community channels.

Enjoy your game!

Best regards,
KumaStar Game Studio

notes.title: FIX
notes.content:

Adjusted difficulty levels for some maps.

notes.title: Button prompt update
notes.content:
We sincerely apologize for our oversight in not displaying the button prompts for the first phase of the final battle.

When entering the final battle, please rapidly press the "spacebar" to advance the red panda into the green zone. Only then can you break through and obtain the final ingredient.

In this version, we have updated the UI to include the button prompts.

Once again, we extend our sincere apologies for this mistake!

We hope this has not affected your gaming experience.
